Change the session read of the probe.
- Breaking: a list item with a dash.
* Breaking: a list item with a star.
+ Breaking: a list item with a plus.
1. Breaking: a numbered list item.
> Breaking: a quote.
  Breaking: an indented line.
breaking: a line in lower case.
Breaking: a later line at the line start.
